# Task: mean5 vs last-observation backtest (seeds 0-9)

## Predictions (written before building)
User: mean5 MAE <= 0.8 x last MAE (i.e. >=20% cut). Disproved if any/aggregate ratio mean5/last > 0.8.
Claude: mean5 ~3x worse than last (ratio ~3.0, ~3.1-3.2 MAE vs ~1.0). Disproved if ratio < 1 (or any seed <= 0.8 x).

## Premise check
User said "observation for every calendar day": FALSE. run.py drops days 17,34,51,68,85 -> 95 rows, 5 gaps per seed.

## Agreed rules (user)
- Score only final 20 eligible targets (by date).
- Do not fill missing days. Eligible = target and 5 preceding observations occupy 6 consecutive calendar days.
- Seeds 0-9, MAE in units/day. Delivery: Claude's judgment.

## Deviations / log
(see below)

def test_eligibility_skips_gaps_and_takes_last_window():
    from datetime import date, timedelta
    from run import eligible_errors
    days = [d for d in range(30) if d != 10]
    rows = [{"date": (date(2025, 1, 1) + timedelta(days=d)).isoformat(), "value": float(d)} for d in days]
    got = eligible_errors(rows, window=20)
    # targets day 5..9 ok(5), day 10 missing, 11-15 ineligible (window includes gap), 16..29 ok
    assert [e["date"] for e in got][-1] == "2025-01-30"
    assert all(date.fromisoformat(e["date"]) not in {date(2025, 1, k) for k in range(12, 17)} for e in got)
    assert len(got) == 19 - 0 or len(got) == 20


def test_report_shape():
    from run import build_report
    r = build_report()
    assert len(r["runs"]) == 10 and all(x["scored"] == 20 for x in r["runs"])
    assert all(x["missing_days"] == 5 for x in r["runs"])
